### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Compare sequence-summed versus length-normalized Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) advantages to assess response length bias in reasoning models.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import numpy as np

def cs336_l16_grpo_length_normalization_audit(rewards: list, lengths: list, normalize_by_length: bool = True) -> list:
    r = np.array(rewards, dtype=float)
    adv = (r - np.mean(r)) / (np.std(r) + 1e-8)
    if normalize_by_length: adv = adv / np.array(lengths, dtype=float)
    return np.round(adv, 6).tolist()
```
